items.source: MethodInterceptors and Advisors are identified by a list of bean names in the current bean factory, specified through the "interceptorNames" property. The last entry in the list can be the name of a target bean or a TargetSource; however, it is normally preferable to use the "targetName"/"target"/"targetSource" properties instead.
items.translation: MethodInterceptors 和 Advisors 通过当前 Bean 工厂中的 Bean 名称列表进行标识，该列表由 "interceptorNames" 属性指定。列表中的最后一个条目可以是目标 Bean 的名称或一个 TargetSource；然而，通常更推荐使用 "targetName"/"target"/"targetSource" 属性。

items.source: NOTE: Specifying a target bean as final name in the "interceptorNames" list is deprecated and will be removed in a future Spring version. Use the "targetName" property instead.
items.translation: 注意：在 "interceptorNames" 列表中指定目标 bean 的最终名称已弃用，将在未来的 Spring 版本中移除。请使用 "targetName" 属性代替。

items.source: Global interceptors and advisors can be added at the factory level. The specified ones are expanded in an interceptor list where an "xxx*" entry is included in the list, matching the given prefix with the bean names — for example, "global*" would match both "globalBean1" and "globalBean2"; whereas, "*" would match all defined interceptors. The matching interceptors get applied according to their returned order value, if they implement the Ordered interface.
items.translation: 全局拦截器和顾问可以在工厂级别添加。指定的那些会在拦截器列表中展开，如果列表中包含 "xxx*" 条目，则会与 bean 名称匹配给定的前缀——例如，"global*" 将匹配 "globalBean1" 和 "globalBean2"；而 "*" 将匹配所有定义的拦截器。匹配的拦截器将根据其返回的顺序值应用（如果它们实现了 Ordered 接口）。

items.source: It's possible to cast a proxy obtained from this factory to Advised, or to obtain the ProxyFactoryBean reference and programmatically manipulate it. This won't work for existing prototype references, which are independent. However, it will work for prototypes subsequently obtained from the factory. Changes to interception will work immediately on singletons (including existing references). However, to change interfaces or a target it's necessary to obtain a new instance from the factory. This means that singleton instances obtained from the factory do not have the same object identity. However, they do have the same interceptors and target, and changing any reference will change all objects.
items.translation: 可以将从此工厂获取的代理强制转换为 Advised，或者获取 ProxyFactoryBean 引用并对其进行程序化操作。这不适用于现有的原型引用，因为它们相互独立。但是，对于随后从工厂获取的原型，此方法有效。对拦截器的更改会立即在单例（包括现有引用）上生效。然而，若要更改接口或目标，则必须从工厂获取新实例。这意味着从工厂获取的单例实例不具有相同的对象身份。但是，它们具有相同的拦截器和目标，更改任何引用都会更改所有对象。

items.source: The default implementation uses a getProxy call with the factory's bean class loader. Can be overridden to specify a custom class loader.
items.translation: 默认实现使用工厂的类加载器调用 `getProxy`。可以重写该方法以指定自定义类加载器。

items.source:
Creates a JDK proxy when proxy interfaces are given, and a CGLIB proxy for the
actual target class if not. Note that the latter will only work if the target class
does not have final methods, as a dynamic subclass will be created at runtime.
items.translation: 当给定代理接口时，会创建 JDK 代理；否则，将为实际的目标类创建 CGLIB 代理。请注意，后者仅在目标类不包含 final 方法时才有效，因为运行时将创建一个动态子类。

items.source:
This is essentially equivalent to the "setInterfaces" method,
but mirrors TransactionProxyFactoryBean's "setProxyInterfaces".
items.translation: 这本质上与"setInterfaces"方法等效，但镜像了 TransactionProxyFactoryBean 的"setProxyInterfaces"。

items.source:
The referenced beans should be of type Interceptor, Advisor or Advice
The last entry in the list can be the name of any bean in the factory.
If it's neither an Advice nor an Advisor, a new SingletonTargetSource
is added to wrap it. Such a target bean cannot be used if the "target"
or "targetSource" or "targetName" property is set, in which case the
"interceptorNames" array must contain only Advice/Advisor bean names.
items.translation: 引用的 Bean 应为 Interceptor、Advisor 或 Advice 类型。列表中的最后一个条目可以是工厂中任意 Bean 的名称。如果它既不是 Advice 也不是 Advisor，则会添加一个新的 SingletonTargetSource 来包装它。如果设置了"target"、"targetSource"或"targetName"属性，则不能使用此类目标 Bean；在这种情况下，"interceptorNames"数组必须仅包含 Advice/Advisor Bean 名称。

items.source:
You can also specify a target object or a TargetSource object
directly, via the "target"/"targetSource" property, respectively.
items.translation: 您也可以通过各自的 "target"/"targetSource" 属性直接指定目标对象或 TargetSource 对象。

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this flag off to create a CGLIB
proxy for the full target class if no interfaces specified.
items.translation: 默认值为"true"。关闭此标志可为未指定接口的完整目标类创建 CGLIB 代理。

items.source: Return a proxy. Invoked when clients obtain beans from this factory bean. Create an instance of the AOP proxy to be returned by this factory. The instance will be cached for a singleton, and create on each call to getObject() for a proxy.
items.translation:
返回代理。当客户端从此工厂 Bean 获取 Bean 时调用。
创建此工厂要返回的 AOP 代理实例。
对于单例，该实例将被缓存；对于 `getObject()` 调用的每个请求，将创建一个代理。

items.source: This suffix in a value in an interceptor list indicates to expand globals.
items.translation: 拦截器列表中的值后缀指示展开全局变量。

items.source: Blow away and recache singleton on an advice change.
items.translation: 在建议变更时清除并重新缓存单例。

items.source:
Set the value of the singleton property. Governs whether this factory
should always return the same proxy instance (which implies the same target)
or whether it should return a new prototype instance, which implies that
the target and interceptors may be new instances also, if they are obtained
from prototype bean definitions. This allows for fine control of
independence/uniqueness in the object graph.
items.translation: 设置单例属性的值。控制此工厂是否应始终返回相同的代理实例（这意味着相同的目标），还是返回一个新的原型实例，这意味着如果它们是从原型 Bean 定义中获取的，则目标和拦截器也可能是新实例。这允许对对象图中的独立性/唯一性进行精细控制。

items.source:
Return the type of the proxy. Will check the singleton instance if
already created, else fall back to the proxy interface (in case of just
a single one), the target bean type, or the TargetSource's target class.
items.translation: 返回代理的类型。如果已创建单例实例，则进行检查；否则回退到代理接口（如果是单个的话）、目标 Bean 类型或 TargetSource 的目标类。

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口可以通过其SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype()方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通FactoryBean实现，如果isSingleton()实现返回 false，则假定其始终返回独立实例。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() method or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充后之后但初始化回调（如 InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() 方法或自定义 init-method）之前之前调用。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后，但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source:
When a config is frozen, no advice changes can be made. This is
useful for optimization, and useful when we don't want callers to
be able to manipulate configuration after casting to Advised.
items.translation: 当配置被冻结时，无法进行任何建议（advice）更改。这对于优化很有用，并且在我们不希望调用者在转换为 Advised 后操纵配置时也很有用。

items.source:
Default is the bean ClassLoader, i.e. the ClassLoader used by the
containing BeanFactory for loading all bean classes. This can be
overridden here for specific proxies.
items.translation: 默认值为 Bean ClassLoader，即包含该 BeanFactory 用于加载所有 Bean 类的 ClassLoader。此处可针对特定代理进行覆盖。

items.source:
The singleton status of the FactoryBean itself will generally
be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。
